$schema: sidecar for DESIGN.md — mirrors frontend/src/app.css :root exactly; keep in sync

meta.world: ham-radio waterfall / spectrum scope instrument panel

chassis.note: v42: bg-1 is the raised faceplate (1.17:1 vs bg-0); line is the quiet divider, line-control the >=3:1 border of every control (WCAG 1.4.11)

text.note: v42: dim reaches 4.5:1 on bg-0/1/2 (5.63/4.83/4.62); signal-dim is never text

signal.meaning: live/active only — exclusive, never used as permanent chrome or decoration

waiting.meaning: patient, scheduled, not alarming — the retry ladder's normal state

fail.meaning: terminal failure only — never used for waiting/backoff
fail.note: v42: fail-edge is a destructive control outline at rest (>=3:1); fail-dim is a fill/segment tone, never a control edge

focus.meaning: keyboard focus ring, never suppressed (hard accessibility requirement)

families.font-mono: 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, monospace

typography.rule: mono = numbers, timestamps, state tokens, addresses, idents and (until v47) control labels; sans = content, sentences, hints, errors, empty-state copy (v39 F12, narrowed in v42)

scale.note: v42: fixed rem roles; body is var(--fs-body), so text follows the user setting. v41/v43 files still carry literals (the off-scale ones: the login dial ticks 0.5625rem and one TrackRow 0.875rem) until v43/v47 migrate them

space.note: space-7/space-8 defined but not yet consumed by any built component

rowGrid.note: v41: shared columns of JobRow, TrackRow, the expanded detail and the tracks-scope group header; a nested track list indents by row-nest

motion.reducedMotion: all three durations zeroed globally under prefers-reduced-motion; every bespoke @keyframes literal-duration animation additionally needs its own override
